title: Agent API Routes
description: Complete partner agent-facing API with authentication, registration, dashboard, inventory management, lead access, appointment handling, and deal closing. Implements package-based differentiation (FREE vs PRO/ADVANCE_PRO) with data masking for FREE agents.
features: Authentication: Login OTP generation and verification
Registration: Agent registration with package selection
Dashboard: Stats for inventory, leads, appointments, deals closed, commission earned
Inventory Management: List agent's properties with filters
Lead Access: List leads with package-based data masking
FREE agents: Buyer phone/name masked, contact via Realty Pandit only
PRO/ADVANCE_PRO agents: Full buyer contact details visible
Appointment Handling: List appointments, update status
Deal Closing: Close deal with commission tracking for FREE agents
Agent-specific data filtering (only see own inventory/leads)
acceptance_criteria: Leads show masked data for FREE agents
Leads show full data for PRO/ADVANCE_PRO agents
Close deal endpoint tracks commission for FREE agents
result_summary: Complete agent API with authentication, registration, dashboard, inventory, leads, appointments, and deal closing. Package-based access control ensures FREE agents see masked buyer data while PRO+ agents get full access. Commission tracking for FREE agents implemented. Production-ready for agent portal frontend.
